tokens.name: rhino
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (RGB 46 53 88 · CMYK 48/40/0/65). The wordmark, headings on white, primary dark grounds. 11.9:1 on white.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Secondary / accent (RGB 140 157 255 · CMYK 45/38/0/0). Supporting highlight only — fills, glows, highlighted words on dark. Never body text on white (2.5:1).

tokens.name: chrome-yellow
tokens.usage: Secondary / accent (RGB 255 166 1 · CMYK 0/35/100/0). Calls to action, stripe motif, key highlights on rhino grounds (6.1:1). Never text on white (2.0:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Core neutral. Light grounds and text on rhino, rhino-950 and midnight.

tokens.name: rangoon-black
tokens.usage: Core neutral (CMYK 0/0/0/90). Long-form body text on white (17.4:1) and dark print collateral.

tokens.name: rhino-950
tokens.usage: Rhino semitone — the deepest rhino. Base dark background (one of the three 80% base colours).

tokens.name: rhino-800
tokens.usage: Rhino semitone. Raised dark panels and hairlines on rhino-950.

tokens.name: rhino-600
tokens.usage: Rhino semitone. Deep blue fills; white text on it is 8.7:1.

tokens.name: rhino-500
tokens.usage: Rhino semitone. Brightest rhino; links and accent text on white (4.8:1).

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Gradient stop (RGB 13 16 40 · CMYK 67/60/0/84) for Gradient 02 and Background 04; also the header wordmark ink on white.

tokens.name: periwinkle-600
tokens.usage: Periwinkle semitone. Saturated accent fills; large text only on white (4.0:1).

tokens.name: periwinkle-300
tokens.usage: Periwinkle semitone. Muted text and icons on rhino-950 (8.9:1) and rhino (6.5:1).

tokens.name: periwinkle-100
tokens.usage: Periwinkle semitone. Light tint panels, partner-brand tiles, Background 03 fade.

tokens.name: chrome-yellow-400
tokens.usage: Chrome Yellow semitone. Hover state of chrome-yellow fills.

tokens.name: chrome-yellow-200
tokens.usage: Chrome Yellow semitone. Soft highlight fills behind rhino text.

tokens.name: chrome-yellow-100
tokens.usage: Chrome Yellow semitone. Palest warm tint for callout panels.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Neutral semitone. Dark neutral text alternative on white (12.8:1).

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Neutral semitone. Footers and legal lines in the source; 3.95:1 on white, so only for text 24px+ or non-essential copy.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Neutral semitone. Light grey logo plate, hairline dividers on white (decorative, 1.2:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. White in light; rhino-950 in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and tiles sitting on surface.

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Inverted / hero bands inside a page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body on surface and surface-raised (light 11.9:1 / 9.4:1; dark 16.2:1 / 11.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, footers. Dark: 8.9:1 on surface. Light keeps the source's #808080 at 3.95:1 on white — FLAG: use only at 24px+ or for legal lines; use ink for anything essential.

tokens.name: ink-accent
tokens.usage: Highlighted words and links on surface (light 4.8:1, dark 6.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Periwinkle fill for supporting highlights — glows, secondary buttons, chips.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (6.5:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Chrome Yellow fill for the one primary action or key mark per view.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight fills (6.1:1 / 8.2:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Not for control borders that must be seen.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline (light 4.8:1 on white, dark 8.2:1 on rhino-950).

families.sans: "Avenir LT Pro", "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Nunito Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Heading H1 — Avenir LT Pro Bold 96px. One per slide or page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Heading H2 — Avenir LT Pro Semi Bold 64px.

styles.name: sh1
styles.usage: Sub Headline SH1 — Avenir LT Pro Medium 64px.

styles.name: sh2
styles.usage: Sub Headline SH2 — Avenir LT Pro Medium 48px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We transform how you think by connecting you with experienced problem-solvers.
styles.usage: Paragraph Body — Avenir LT Pro Book 48px on the 1920px canvas.

styles.name: social-headline
styles.usage: Social media (short-form, carousels, statics): letter spacing -4 to -6%, line spacing 95–120%. Size follows the scale slot used.

styles.name: print-headline
styles.usage: Print & high-detail collateral (brochures, PPTs, PDFs): letter spacing 0 to -2%, line spacing 100–120%.

styles.name: ui-headline
styles.usage: UI & digital interfaces (web, dashboards, apps): letter spacing 0%, default line spacing.

styles.name: explainer-italic
styles.usage: Besley Italic — explainer titles and one emphasised phrase beside Avenir. Never long-form.

styles.name: display-futura
styles.usage: Futura Bold — short uppercase display labels, may take a brand gradient fill.

styles.name: hand-note
styles.usage: Figma Hand — a short handwritten aside. Never paired as a headline with Avenir, never long-form.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label, stacked caption lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button padding block, gaps inside cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters between tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Section padding on small canvases; page margins on the 1080 social formats.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page margins on the 1920 canvas and large section breaks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Overlay button-tiles and their inner squares (measured from Color Combinations).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Value cards and large panels (measured from Our Values).

tokens.name: glow-periwinkle
tokens.usage: The periwinkle under-glow on value cards; dark grounds only.

gradient.note: Brand gradients and the approved background treatments, as CSS background values. Use them as background, never as text colour on body copy.

tokens.name: gradient-01
tokens.usage: Gradient 01 — Rhino into Periwinkle. Hero panels and covers. Direction and stops measured from the guidelines.

tokens.name: gradient-02
tokens.usage: Gradient 02 — Rhino with a Midnight core. Deep, quiet dark grounds.

tokens.name: gradient-03
tokens.usage: Gradient 03 — Chrome Yellow into Periwinkle. Rare, expressive moments; set rhino-950 or white type at display size only.

tokens.name: gradient-04
tokens.usage: Gradient 04 — White into Periwinkle. Light, airy panels; rhino text.

tokens.name: gradient-amalgamation
tokens.usage: Amalgamation — all core colours blended. Campaign key visuals only; approximation of a mesh gradient.

tokens.name: background-01
tokens.usage: Approved Background 01 — dusk fade from lifted rhino to rhino-950 (top stop sampled).

tokens.name: background-03
tokens.usage: Approved Background 03 — white with a periwinkle-100 fade at the foot.

tokens.name: background-04
tokens.usage: Approved Background 04 — midnight lifting to rhino at the foot.
